racials.name: Will to Survive
racials.effect: Break out of a stun.

racials.name: Perception
racials.effect: Spot stealthed enemies for 20 seconds.

racials.name: Ruthless
racials.effect: +1% critical strike chance, whatever weapon or spell you use.
racials.change: Oct 26: 2% → 1%. It replaced Sword Specialization on Oct 15.

racials.name: The Human Spirit
racials.effect: +10% Spirit.

priest.name: Divine Grace
priest.effect: Instantly heal an ally below 50% health (not yourself).

racials.name: Stoneform
racials.effect: For 8 seconds: immune to bleeds, poisons and diseases, and take less physical damage.

racials.name: Find Treasure
racials.effect: Track treasure chests, which sometimes hold extra loot for you.
racials.change: Oct 15 beta: chance for extra items.

racials.name: Artisan's Precision
racials.effect: +1% chance to hit with spells and attacks.
racials.change: Oct 26: replaced Earth Fury (+2% critical damage and healing), which had replaced Mace Specialization on Oct 15.

racials.name: Big Game Hunter
racials.effect: +5% damage against Beasts.

priest.name: Chastise
priest.effect: Root a humanoid in place for 2 seconds.

racials.name: Escape Artist
racials.effect: Briefly become immune to roots and snares.

racials.name: Eureka!
racials.effect: For 8 seconds your spells and abilities cost less and deal +10% damage and healing.
racials.change: Oct 15 beta: now an 8-second buff (was 3 charges); not usable in stealth.

racials.name: Expansive Mind
racials.effect: +5% maximum mana, rage or energy.

racials.name: Engineering Specialization
racials.effect: Your engineering gadgets are more reliable.

priest.name: Confounding Flash
priest.effect: Confuse up to 5 nearby enemies for 3 seconds; damage breaks it.

priest.name: Contingency Plan
priest.effect: Ward an ally: if they drop below 35% health they get a shield and a heal over time.

racials.name: Elune's Light
racials.effect: +10% critical strike chance for 15 seconds.

racials.name: Shadowmeld
racials.effect: Turn invisible while standing still.

racials.name: Quickness
racials.effect: +1% dodge chance and +2% run speed.
racials.change: Oct 15 beta: the speed bonus now stacks with others.

racials.name: Wisp Spirit
racials.effect: +75% run speed as a ghost after dying.

priest.name: Starshards
priest.effect: A much stronger damage spell, now on a 30-second cooldown.

priest.name: Elune's Grace
priest.effect: Attacks are 50% less likely to hit you for 15 seconds, or until 3 of them miss.

racials.name: Blood Fury
racials.effect: +10% attack power and spell power for 15 seconds (2-minute cooldown).
racials.change: Oct 26: cooldown back to 2 minutes (it was 3 minutes after Oct 15).

racials.name: Shatter Curse
racials.effect: Remove curses and banes from yourself, then take 5% less magic damage for 8 seconds.
racials.change: Oct 15 beta: dispels instead of granting immunity; 15% → 5%.

racials.name: Command
racials.effect: Your Hunter or Warlock pet deals 5% more damage.
racials.change: Oct 26: back from Classic, replacing Savage (+1% critical strike chance), which had replaced Axe Specialization on Oct 15.

racials.name: Hardiness
racials.effect: Stuns on you last 20% shorter.

racials.name: Will of the Forsaken
racials.effect: Break free of charm, fear and sleep.

racials.name: Cannibalize
racials.effect: Feed on a corpse to restore 35% of your health and mana over time.
racials.change: Nov 2: usable again while you're immune to physical damage.

racials.name: Underwater Breathing
racials.effect: Hold your breath 300% longer.

racials.name: Touch of the Grave
racials.effect: Your attacks and spells sometimes drain health from the target.
racials.change: Oct 15 beta: proc retuned (about 30% for casters, 20% for Paladin/Rogue/Warrior). Oct 26: internal cooldown 25 → 15 seconds. Nov 2: fixed so it triggers as often as intended.

priest.name: Dark Sacrifice
priest.effect: Turn your own health into mana over time (scales with Spirit).

racials.name: War Stomp
racials.effect: Stun nearby enemies for 2 seconds (90-second cooldown).
racials.change: Oct 15 beta: cooldown 2 minutes → 90 seconds.

racials.name: Cultivation
racials.effect: Grow bonus herbs anyone can gather, no Herbalism needed (15-minute cooldown).
racials.change: Oct 15 beta: cooldown 60 → 15 minutes.

racials.name: Plainsrunning
racials.effect: Run faster the longer you keep moving, up to +60% (not while mounted).
racials.change: Oct 26: 2% per stack up to +60% (was 1% up to +30%), and no more mounted speed. Since Oct 15, stutter-stepping no longer keeps it active.

racials.name: Endurance
racials.effect: +5% maximum health.
racials.change: Oct 26: only the +5% health is left (the +1% hit, and the +2% critical damage and healing from Oct 15, are gone).

racials.name: Berserking
racials.effect: +10% attack and casting speed for 15 seconds.
racials.change: Oct 26: 10 → 15 seconds.

racials.name: Rapid Regeneration

racials.effect: +5% damage against Beasts.
